reasons: All ten atomic preferred elements are present in the inserted subsection (c): professional and workmanlike Services (90 days), deliverables/software conformance to documentation (12 months), compliance with laws, no malicious code, and repair/replacement/refund remedies. Preferred level is complete.
The insertion is appropriate because Section 9 contained no performance warranty at all, so a concise inserted clause is the right instrument.

Minimality fails on two additions not needed to complete the preferred level: the qualifier "consistent with prevailing industry standards", which dilutes the standalone "professional and workmanlike" standard, and "at HDI's option", which hands the choice of remedy to the Vendor when the playbook simply lists repair, replace or refund. Both should be deleted.

Minor, non-flagging notes: refund is limited to fees "paid" rather than paid or payable, and the 12-month software period runs from written acceptance rather than delivery; neither defeats the preferred position.

No unrelated term is disturbed; the mutual warranties in (a) and the Globix carve-out in (b) remain effective, and the inserted text uses existing defined terms (HDI, Company, Site, Section 5.2) plus a new internal definition of "Services", introducing no dangling mechanic.
